vehicle: Lancia Fulvia Coupe Rallye 1.6 HF, early-1970s rally reconstruction

facts: page 2: wheelbase 2330 mm, tracks 1390/1350 mm, 780 kg without fuel/tools, 38 L tank
page 4: front transverse leaf and independent wishbones, rear dead axle and longitudinal leaves, 257 mm discs
V4, front engine/front drive, competition power over 160 hp

estimated: Approx. 160 CV competition torque curve, gearing and LSD settings; no claim to reproduce a particular works chassis
Crew 150 kg + tools 15 kg added to homologated 780 kg vehicle mass
Component masses, inertias, CG, damping, rates, tire force/thermal coefficients, cooling, aero and damage calibration
Suspension kinematics are a four-hub solver proxy; no mechanically coupled rear beam or transverse leaf
120 Hz minimum Jolt world step for the lighter 19 kg hub assemblies; numerical stability setting.

Rally Trophy geometry retained at native scale: 2.480 m wheelbase, 1.220 m tracks, 0.280 m tire radius. The source game model differs from homologation dimensions; simulation follows its measured wheel pivots.

visual_source.occupants: Shared original driver1.bzf meshes and 19 native steering morphs, relocated using Fulvia DriverLoc/CoDriverLoc.

geometry_measurement.method: Native metric FBX geometry, no GTA scaling. Four high-detail wheel mesh bounds and pivots. Source Rally Trophy geometry retained; geometric source is not a measured historical chassis.

audio_source: Native car_13.bzf EE/EX engine/exhaust; byte-identical originals plus documented derived coast/lift and generic synthesized gearbox tones.
